# What does your sticker price really collect? Discount rate and net tuition

> Free tuition discount calculator for independent schools. Enter sticker tuition and your financial aid groups; it shows the discount rate, net tuition per student, break-even enrollment and what a tuition increase really adds. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
